facts.fact: 往 Crannhyr 还要走好几天，这段路让一行人后悔此前把大部分马都放走了。
facts.anchor: regret having set most of their horses free

facts.fact: Flann 从 Father Gwynn 的积蓄里取了几枚小银币，向低地 Dillathi 的农夫买了一辆破车。
facts.anchor: bought a rickety wagon from a farmer

facts.fact: Liam 腿上有箭伤，虽执意不肯，仍被禁止再骑马，只能与 Xaniko 一起坐车。
facts.anchor: Long Liam and his arrow-wounded leg were not allowed on horseback any longer

facts.fact: Flann 答应 Mearna：等他把 Hagan 的头从身上砍下那天，会带来给她。
facts.anchor: bring you Hagan’s head on the day I finally

facts.fact: Vedra 追问 Daley：他走了近两个整月，却什么也不肯说。
facts.anchor: You were gone for near two full moons

facts.fact: Mud Boy 侦察回来说 Threadbare Hall 的院子里全是人，但看着不像士兵。
facts.anchor: The hall’s gateyard is full of people

facts.fact: Xaniko 在车斗里睁开眼，嗓音干得像 Nascadu 的沙丘，说听得见 Vedra。
facts.anchor: in a voice as dry as the Nascadu dunes

facts.fact: Hagan 在信里说他认为 Scaeth 找到了新盟友，想亲自来向 First Lord 说明。
facts.anchor: He says that he thinks Scaeth has found some new ally
